title: Rapid pinback protocol and heatcheck notes
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal notes for a lightweight, rapid pinback and heatcheck protocol for canaries. Aim: give SREs / on-call a short checklist to safely ramp and then quickly revert/pin without needing the full war room. Not a policy doc — scratchpad for iterating the playbook.

Context / assumptions:
- We do fast canaries for model and infra changes (0.5% -> 20% traffic over ~1h).
- There are two failure modes to distinguish: model-quality regression (semantic drift, hallucination, output format break) vs infra/regressions (OOMs, kernel crashes, increased latency).
- We have an admin API that supports immediate "pin" to model: POST /admin/pin?model=... and a routing control plane to throttle percents.

Key goals:
1) Detect problems early with a compact heatcheck sequence.
2) Provide a one-command pinback that keeps customers on last-good variant while we triage.
3) Minimize blast radius and avoid long tail incidents.

Heatcheck sequence (fast):
- Phase 0: preflight (T-minus 0) — 1 min before first traffic shift:
  - Ensure canary infra nodes are green (kube node Ready, disk <60% used).
  - Confirm no active deploys in other regions.
  - Quick smoke: curl /health on canary router, sample generate for 3 canned prompts (latency + correctness).

- Phase 1: probe (0 -> 0.5% traffic, 10 minutes)
  - Duration: 10m. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, error_rate (5xx & app errors), cost/spike, acceptance ratio.
  - Quick thresholds (heuristic):
    * error_rate > 0.5% OR
    * p95 latency > baseline_p95 * 1.4 OR
    * Successful generate rate (non-empty, not truncated) drops by >6%
    => Pause ramp and run short triage.
  - If no triggers, continue.

- Phase 2: early ramp (0.5% -> 3%, 20 minutes)
  - Duration: 20m. Monitor model-quality quick checks: small eval set of 12 prompts run end-to-end through canary (automated) every 5m. Check for changes in expected outputs (token-level diffs, broken JSON shapes).
  - Heuristic for model regression: any of the eval prompts produce malformed JSON (for structured responses) OR model-safety score drops by >10%
  - If regression suspected: immediate pinback.

- Phase 3: confident ramp (3% -> 20%, 30–60 minutes)
  - Longer observation windows. Watch tail latencies (p99), queue build-up, autoscaler churn.
  - Acceptable small oscillations ok; watch for sustained trend for 2 windows (2 x 5m).

Rapid pinback protocol (one-button mindset):
- Goal: get traffic off canary variant within 60s of decision.
- Preconditions: identify last-good variant id (we store last_good_model in deployment metadata).
- Mechanisms (order matters):
  1) Admin API pin: POST /admin/pin {"target":"<last_good_model>"} — this should instant-roll traffic to the pinned model at routing layer (soft handover).
  2) If routing control fails or partial clients still hit canary: throttle canary to 1% via /admin/route set-percent.
  3) Scale down canary workers: kubectl scale deployment/<canary-dep> --replicas=0 (or safe drain script) to avoid continued execution.
  4) If suspect infra crashes, also cordon nodes and run quick kernel/ftrace collection.
  5) Post-pin: run smoke suite against pinned variant and send ephemeral incident slack message with initial summary.

Triage checklist (first 15 minutes):
- Check logs for OOMs, CUDA errors, serialized exceptions.
- Pull model eval diffs (automated job) and eyeball top 3 divergent prompts.
- Confirm whether failures are repeatable on single requests or only at scale (rate-dependent).
- If model-quality regression: open a Model-Rollback ticket, tag model owners, and schedule follow-up eval.
- If infra: open infra incident, involve infra on-call, collect node diagnostics.

Concrete thresholds (proposal, tune over time):
- Immediate abort/pin triggers:
  * 5xx error rate > 1% for 3 consecutive 1-minute buckets.
  * p95 latency increases > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive buckets.
  * Any structured-output schema break observed by auto-eval.
- Soft pause/pause-and-observe triggers:
  * error rate 0.3%–1% or p95 latency 1.3x–2x baseline — pause ramp, hold for 10m and re-evaluate.

Rapid diagnostics cheat-sheet (commands):
- Pin via admin: curl -X POST "$ADMIN_URL/admin/pin" -d '{"model":"<last_good_model>"}'
- Throttle routing: curl -X POST "$ADMIN_URL/admin/route" -d '{"variant":"canary","pct":1}'
- Check pods: kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=serving,variant=canary
- Scale down: kubectl -n prod scale deployment/<canary-dep> --replicas=0
- Tail logs (app): kubectl -n prod logs -f deployment/<canary-dep> --since=10m | grep -iE "error|exception|oom|cuda"

Client-affinity notes (when to avoid immediate pin):
- Some enterprise customers are pinned at client-side; pinning at routing layer won't affect them. If a major customer is impacted, open a targeted fallback route for that API key (we have route overrides per client).
- If problem is deterministic for a client cohort, consider cohort-wise pin rather than global.

Postmortem quick fields (add to ticket):
- What changed (image/model id, config diffs)
- Timeline (minutes granularity) — exact timestamps for first observed sign, pin, full recovery
- Root cause hypothesis and evidence (logs, eval diffs)
- Mitigations short-term + long-term

Open questions / TODOs for iteration:
- Should we make pinback atomic across regions? Right now pins are per-route; cross-region customers might see inconsistent behavior.
- Add a synthetic eval that checks hallucination rate for high-risk prompts; need to design set.
- Automate the one-click "pin + scale down canary + notify" button in console.
- Tweak thresholds for p95 vs p99 depending on model family (smaller models tolerate higher p95 variance).

Notes from last incident (quick memory dump):
- 2024-07-22: model vX.24 caused subtle schema truncation at 1% traffic after 8m. Auto-eval flagged 2/12 prompts with JSON key missing. Pinback via admin API worked and clients saw no outage. Took ~12m to triage.
- Lesson: add immediate structured-output smoke checks in phase 1.

Sign-offs / follow-ups:
- Priya to prototype the one-click console action (low friction).
- Liam to add quick eval job that runs the 12-prompt suite every 5m for canaries.
- Me (Samir) to try this protocol during next small deploy and note timings.

Quick checklist (copyable):
- [ ] Preflight smoke OK
- [ ] Probe 0.5% (10m) — monitor p95, errors, quick eval
- [ ] Early ramp 3% (20m) — automated eval runs ok
- [ ] Confident ramp -> target %
- [ ] If triggered -> POST /admin/pin last_good_model -> throttle -> scale down
- [ ] Triage logs + eval diffs
- [ ] Create ticket and populate postmortem fields

Endnotes: this is intentionally terse. Want feedback from Priya/Liam on what to automate next. Keep tuning thresholds conservatively until we have more run history with the new routing primitives.
